title: Affine detector counting with asymmetric marked reserves at 0.874840
description: Submission of the canonical all-moduli Dirichlet bound 21871/25000 (0.874840); official admission remains pending. Combines timbalud's asymmetric marked counting and coupled radical allocation (PR50) with DaysSky's affine detector-count source integration (PR56), using Hailey Collet's Cycle61 interior affine moment theorem for each detector character. Uses h=1989/2500 and lower height 159/200. Prepared with AI assistance; inherited mathematical attribution and source notices retained.
